name: Morning Market Breakfast
effect: Line up 3 daytime FOOD vendors before dusk (drinks don't count). The island wakes up eating — soy milk, egg crepe, hot congee — and you want in before the stalls pack up.
art_note: Boarding-pass ticket: sunrise over a market arcade, three little breakfast bowls stamped in a row.

name: Beat the Crowds
effect: Win 3 vendors BEFORE dusk. Get in before the queues form and the street turns over.
art_note: Ticket: a wide-awake owl over a sunrise market, a short queue just starting to form.

name: Check-in Trail
effect: Your won daytime tables cost at least 7 ingredients in total — the daytime spots worth queueing for, the priciest bites of the morning. Judged at dusk.
art_note: Ticket: a phone framing a bowl over a rising daytime crowd.

name: Dragon-Boat Food Run
effect: Line up 3 FOOD vendors before dusk (drinks don't count). The Dragon-Boat outing — sticky-rice zongzi unwrapped by the river, drums pounding as the boats race at the wharf. Land all three before the day runs out.
art_note: Ticket: a dragon-boat prow on a river
column12: three festival food parcels along the bank.

name: Coin-Snack Tour
effect: Win 3 vendors each costing 2 ingredients or fewer, before dusk. The beloved 銅板美食 budget crawl — big flavour, small change. A day-locked gamble.
art_note: Ticket: three little coins beside a paper snack tray and a receipt.

name: Out-Hype the Rival
effect: Win 1 CONTESTED vendor before dusk (your rival had Followers on it when you won). They were mid-pitch at the hot stall — and you SNATCHED it out from under them. With daylight to spare.
art_note: Ticket: two hands reaching for one glowing stall.

name: Mid-Autumn BBQ
effect: Win 3 night-market FOOD vendors. It's Mid-Autumn and the whole island's out on the pavement firing up the grill — mooncakes stacked, a pomelo rind on some kid's head. Three stalls, go.
art_note: Ticket: a night grill glowing under a full moon, a pomelo beside it.

name: Neon Bites
effect: Win 2 night-market FOOD vendors. Two stalls in one blazing neon lane — snag them before a rival's crowd fills the aisle.
art_note: Ticket: two glowing night stalls.

name: Chasing a Star
effect: Win a ★ apex vendor. A region's top table — a Michelin / 必比登 name.
art_note: Ticket: a hand plucking a gold star from a marquee sign.

name: Marquee Splurge
effect: Win a vendor costing 4 or more ingredients. Splash out on a marquee 名店 — the big name worth every ingredient of it.
art_note: Ticket: a fat wallet snapping open over a feast.

name: Two-Marquee Feast
effect: Win 2 vendors each costing 4 or more ingredients. A big-name double bill.
art_note: Ticket: two heavy coin purses on a night stall.

name: Border Dish
effect: Win 1 cross-region (→X) dish — a recipe that packed its bags and crossed a regional line to reach the plate.
art_note: Ticket: a dish straddling two region stamps.

name: Two Borders
effect: Win 2 cross-region (→X) dishes. Two recipes that each hopped a regional border to land on your tour.
art_note: Ticket: two dishes each straddling two regions.

name: Closing-Time Sprint
effect: Win 2 vendors in the FINAL round. Sprint before the shutters roll down.
art_note: Ticket: a departures board flipping to LAST TRAIN.

name: Full-Day Itinerary
effect: Win 4 vendors in total. Pack the day — a proper island day-trip. Finish it any time before the last train.
art_note: Ticket: four little stall stamps laid out on a day-planner grid.

name: Budget Bites
effect: Win 2 vendors each costing 2 ingredients or fewer. Small wallet, big appetite. Finish it any time.
art_note: Ticket: two coins and a small snack in a paper sleeve.

name: Taroko Day Trip
effect: Win 1 East vendor. Ride out east — the marble gorge and the coast road. Finish it any time.
art_note: Ticket stamped EAST: Taroko gorge cliffs over a rice-terrace coastline.

name: Become a Regular
effect: Win 2 vendors in ONE region (any region). Settle in — get to know a place. Finish it any time.
art_note: Ticket: two stamps stacked under one region badge.

name: Taipei–Taichung Line
effect: Win 1 North vendor AND 1 Central vendor. Link the capital and the Central belt — a pork bun and a cup of tea. Finish it any time.
art_note: Ticket: a pork bun and a tea leaf stamped together, a rail line running between them.

name: South-Link Coast Run
effect: Win 1 South vendor AND 1 East vendor. The 南迴 southern-link route — prawns of the coast, rice of the hills. Finish it any time.
art_note: Ticket: a prawn and a rice ear stamped together over a winding coast road.

name: A Bite & a Sip
effect: Win 1 food vendor AND 1 drink. One thing to chew, one thing to sip — the golden rule of the street. Finish it any time.
art_note: Ticket: a bowl and a cup side by side.

name: The Breakfast Set
effect: Win 1 daytime food AND 1 drink. The classic morning set — a bite and a cup. Finish it any time.
art_note: Ticket: a breakfast bowl and a morning cup.

name: Hand-Shaken Trail
effect: Win 2 drink vendors. The 手搖 tea run every afternoon deserves — sip your way across the island
art_note: any time.
column12: Ticket: two sweating cups of iced hand-shaken tea.

name: Dihua Street Food Crawl
effect: Win 1 Dadaocheng (Dihua Street) vendor — the dawn egg-crepe stall or a riverside neon cup — AND 1 night-market food. Start on the old street at dawn, end under the neon.
art_note: Ticket: the red-brick Dihua shophouse arcade of 大稻埕 with a griddled egg crepe and a riverside neon tea cup stamped together.

name: Tainan Old-Capital Crawl
effect: Win 2 Tainan (府城) vendors — milkfish congee and rice-bowl cake by day, coffin bread and shrimp noodles by night. The old capital, stop by stop.
art_note: Ticket stamped 府城: an Anping fort silhouette over a Tainan oyster-flat motif

name: Taichung City Crawl
effect: Win 2 Taichung vendors — the birthplace of bubble tea and the markets around it. A city crawl any time of day.
art_note: Ticket stamped 臺中: a station clock-tower over rolling tea terraces

name: Rice Tour
effect: Win 3 rice-based vendors — ba-wan, congee, rice-bowl cake, bamboo-tube rice, turkey rice. The island runs on rice; taste it any time.
art_note: Ticket: three rice dishes stamped in a row over a terraced paddy strip.

name: Best Bubble Tea — Origin & Neon
effect: Win a bubble-tea cup — a Taichung teahouse's day cup OR a Dadaocheng riverside neon one — AND a night-market bite. The run every bubble-tea fan makes, day into night.
art_note: Ticket: a refined teahouse cup and a riverside neon cup stamped together with a gold pearl.

name: Four-Stop Night Run
effect: Win 4 vendors in total. A busy crossing of the market — finish it any time before the last train.
art_note: Ticket: four stall stamps in a row.

name: The Grand Tour
effect: Win 6 vendors in total. The full album — the grand tour of the island's tables.
art_note: Ticket: a bulging stamp album.

name: Round-Taiwan · Cycling Route No.1
effect: Win a vendor in ALL 4 regions. The full 環島 lap on Cycling Route No.1 — eat your way around the whole coast.
art_note: Ticket: a bicycle over four regional stamps forming a ring around the island.

name: Big Eater's Feast
effect: Win 5 FOOD vendors in total (drinks don't count). Five stalls cleared — the Big Eater's grand crawl, and she's already eyeing a sixth.
art_note: Ticket: a towering stack of five bowls.

name: Top of the Charts
effect: Your won tables cost at least 9 ingredients in total. The priciest, most-sought marquee tables on the island — lean into the big night names.
art_note: Ticket: a towering crowd and raised phones behind a headline stall.

name: True Local
effect: Win 3 vendors in ONE region (any region). A true local fixture.
art_note: Ticket: three stamps stacked under one region badge.

name: Hualien–Taitung Line
effect: Win 2 East vendors. Two stops down the 花東 rift-valley line — Taroko to the roselle coast.
art_note: Ticket stamped EAST twice over a stone-slab grill and a gorge road.

name: Surf & Turf
effect: Win 1 South vendor AND 1 North vendor. The seafood coast meets the capital's grill.
art_note: Ticket: a prawn and a pork bun stamped together.

name: Taroko–Taipei
effect: Win 1 East vendor AND 1 North vendor. Mountain rice meets the capital.
art_note: Ticket: a rice ear and a pork bun stamped together.

name: Taichung–Kaohsiung
effect: Win 1 Central vendor AND 1 South vendor. Tea belt to harbour city.
art_note: Ticket: a tea leaf and a prawn stamped together.

name: Elbow to the Front
effect: Win 2 CONTESTED vendors (rival had Followers on them). Two viral queue stalls, two rivals left blinking — you elbowed to the front of both.
art_note: Ticket: a roaring queue behind a winning agent.

name: Dawn-to-Dusk Full Day
effect: Win one daytime food, one night-market food, and one drink — one of each venue. The whole day on a plate.
art_note: Ticket: a breakfast bowl, a lantern-lit night stall, and a cup in a triptych.

name: One More Round
effect: Win 3 drink vendors in total. 續攤 — keep the night moving, end on something sweet. Finish it any time.
art_note: Ticket: three dessert-and-drink cups in a row.

name: New-Year Market Haul
effect: Win 5 vendors in total. Stocked up for Lunar New Year — the 年貨大街 shopping street at Dihua, arms full.
art_note: Ticket: a red-lantern New-Year market street, dried-goods stalls, five parcels.

name: Money No Object
effect: Your won tables cost at least 7 ingredients in total. 揮金如土 — spare no expense, chase the priciest headline tables.
art_note: Ticket: banknotes fluttering over a banquet.

name: Noodle Run
effect: Win 2 noodle vendors — misua, beef noodle, or the century-old shrimp bowl. Slurp your way across the island, any time.
art_note: Ticket: two steaming noodle bowls stamped over a lantern-lit lane.

name: Fusion Plate
effect: Win 1 cross-region (→X) dish. One plate where two regions' flavours met and got along — finish it any time.
art_note: Ticket: a single dish blending two regions' emblems on one plate.
